name: Mini Minnesota Summer 2023
information:
This competition does not have 3x3 and is not recommended for beginners. If you are looking for a competition in Minnesota with 3x3, please see our Minnesota Meetup II Series: 

[Minnesota Meetup II Wednesday 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIWednesday2023)
[Minnesota Meetup II Thursday 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIThursday2023)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
